hazel.d: any of several shrubs or small trees of the genus Corylus bearing edible nuts enclosed in a leafy husk

hazard.d: take a risk in the hope of a favorable outcome

haze.d: confusion characterized by lack of clarity

hazelnut.d: nut of any of several trees of the genus Corylus

hazelwood.d: reddish-brown wood and lumber from heartwood of the sweet gum tree used to make furniture

hazmat.d: an abbreviation for `hazardous material' used on warning signs

haziness.d: cloudiness resulting from haze or mist or vapor

hazan.d: the official of a synagogue who conducts the liturgical part of the service and sings or chants the prayers intended to be performed as solos

hazard insurance.d: insurance that provides protection against certain risks such as storms or fires

hazel tree.d: Australian tree grown especially for ornament and its fine-grained wood and bearing edible nuts
